text: It is Sunday, the day after the step-up, and Aziz opens the mobile bank at breakfast to check his balance.
prefix: It is Sunday, the day after the step-up, and Aziz opens the mobile bank at breakfast to check his balance.

text: He opens it again at lunch, and once more at night.
prefix: He opens it again at lunch, and once more at night.

text: He never types his password.
prefix: He never types his password.

text: So what lets him in, again and again, without a login?
prefix: So what lets him in, again and again, without a login?

text: Lesson 16 made this phone his money phone, with an app PIN and a binding check at each request.
prefix: Lesson 16 made this phone his money phone, with an app PIN and a binding check at each request.

text: Now look at what the phone carries between two logins.
prefix: Now look at what the phone carries between two logins.

text: It carries an access grant.
prefix: It carries an access grant.

text: An access grant is a session: one app account, on one device, for one customer.
prefix: An access grant is a session: one app account, on one device, for one customer.

text: Aziz got his first grant on registration day, the Sunday before, at level one.
prefix: Aziz got his first grant on registration day, the Sunday before, at level one.

text: He gets a new grant after each login.
prefix: He gets a new grant after each login.

text: Two parts of the platform make a grant, and they have very different jobs.
prefix: Two parts of the platform make a grant, and they have very different jobs.

text: The customer gateway decides.
prefix: The customer gateway decides.

text: It checks the password, the code, the verdict of TAF and the device.
prefix: It checks the password, the code, the verdict of TAF and the device.

text: Keycloak only issues.
prefix: Keycloak only issues.

text: The app never calls Keycloak, since it talks only to the gateway.
prefix: The app never calls Keycloak, since it talks only to the gateway.

text: When the gateway is satisfied, it signs a short note for Keycloak.
prefix: When the gateway is satisfied, it signs a short note for Keycloak.

text: The note says three things: this device, this customer, this level.
prefix: The note says three things: this device, this customer, this level.

text: It is valid for a very short time, and only once.
prefix: It is valid for a very short time, and only once.

text: Keycloak reads the note and issues two tokens: an access token and a refresh token.
prefix: Keycloak reads the note and issues two tokens: an access token and a refresh token.

text: Keycloak is a well-known engine for tokens, but it knows nothing about TAF or MyID.
prefix: Keycloak is a well-known engine for tokens, but it knows nothing about TAF or MyID.

text: So all the rules of the bank stay in the gateway, and a new version of Keycloak never changes a decision.
prefix: So all the rules of the bank stay in the gateway, and a new version of Keycloak never changes a decision.

text: Now read the access token.
prefix: Now read the access token.

text: First, it names its app two times: who the token is for, and which app asked for it.
prefix: First, it names its app two times: who the token is for, and which app asked for it.

text: Here, both names say the mobile bank.
prefix: Here, both names say the mobile bank.

text: The backend of the mobile bank accepts only tokens that were issued for the mobile bank.
prefix: The backend of the mobile bank accepts only tokens that were issued for the mobile bank.

text: A token for any other app gets one answer: session of a different app, log in again.
prefix: A token for any other app gets one answer: session of a different app, log in again.

text: The app comes from the signed token, never from a header that anyone can write.
prefix: The app comes from the signed token, never from a header that anyone can write.

text: Second, the token carries the level of the session: one or two.
prefix: Second, the token carries the level of the session: one or two.

text: The gateway writes level two only for a customer at level two, on his trusted phone.
prefix: The gateway writes level two only for a customer at level two, on his trusted phone.

text: On registration day, Aziz's token said level one.
prefix: On registration day, Aziz's token said level one.

text: On Saturday he passed MyID on this phone, and the gateway issued a new token with level two at once.
prefix: On Saturday he passed MyID on this phone, and the gateway issued a new token with level two at once.

text: He did not wait for the old token to run out.
prefix: He did not wait for the old token to run out.

text: The token also says whether this phone is the money phone.
prefix: The token also says whether this phone is the money phone.

text: So the backend of the mobile bank reads the level and the money phone straight from the token, with no extra call.
prefix: So the backend of the mobile bank reads the level and the money phone straight from the token, with no extra call.

text: Back to breakfast.
prefix: Back to breakfast.

text: The access token lives only for a short, configured time, on purpose.
prefix: The access token lives only for a short, configured time, on purpose.

text: When it runs out, the app asks Aziz for nothing.
prefix: When it runs out, the app asks Aziz for nothing.

text: It sends the refresh token to the gateway, with its device identifier.
prefix: It sends the refresh token to the gateway, with its device identifier.

text: This is a renewal.
prefix: This is a renewal.

text: The gateway renews only for the same device and the same app.
prefix: The gateway renews only for the same device and the same app.

text: First, the renewal passes the binding check from Lesson 16.
prefix: First, the renewal passes the binding check from Lesson 16.

text: Then the gateway looks at its list of ended grants, at each call.
prefix: Then the gateway looks at its list of ended grants, at each call.

text: When both checks pass, Keycloak gives a fresh access token, and a fresh refresh token too.
prefix: When both checks pass, Keycloak gives a fresh access token, and a fresh refresh token too.

text: The old refresh token is now used up, and Keycloak sees it if it ever comes back.
prefix: The old refresh token is now used up, and Keycloak sees it if it ever comes back.

text: A renewal needs no password.
prefix: A renewal needs no password.

text: The password opens a login, and a renewal only continues one.
prefix: The password opens a login, and a renewal only continues one.

text: That is also why the password lock of Lesson 11 ends no grant.
prefix: That is also why the password lock of Lesson 11 ends no grant.

text: There is one more limit: inactivity.
prefix: There is one more limit: inactivity.

text: When Aziz leaves the app alone for longer than the configured limit, the app asks for his app PIN.
prefix: When Aziz leaves the app alone for longer than the configured limit, the app asks for his app PIN.

text: The grant does not end, and the PIN only unlocks the app on this phone.
prefix: The grant does not end, and the PIN only unlocks the app on this phone.

text: The full lifetime of a grant and the inactivity limit are policies, and they come from the installation configuration.
prefix: The full lifetime of a grant and the inactivity limit are policies, and they come from the installation configuration.

text: Now the other side: how a grant ends.
prefix: Now the other side: how a grant ends.

text: First, its lifetime runs out.
prefix: First, its lifetime runs out.

text: Second, the bank blocks the customer, as Lesson 19 shows on the day Aziz loses his phone.
prefix: Second, the bank blocks the customer, as Lesson 19 shows on the day Aziz loses his phone.

text: The grant on the phone then ends at its very next request, not at its next renewal.
prefix: The grant on the phone then ends at its very next request, not at its next renewal.

text: Third, a binding mismatch: the gateway revokes the device, and its grant ends at that request.
prefix: Third, a binding mismatch: the gateway revokes the device, and its grant ends at that request.

text: Fourth, a closure of the customer ends every grant he has.
prefix: Fourth, a closure of the customer ends every grant he has.

text: In each case, the app gets the same answer: this grant has ended.
prefix: In each case, the app gets the same answer: this grant has ended.

text: The app tries a renewal, and when the renewal fails too, Aziz must log in again.
prefix: The app tries a renewal, and when the renewal fails too, Aziz must log in again.

text: Now a check for you.
prefix: Now a check for you.

text: At lunch, after three quiet hours, what does Aziz type: his password, his app PIN, or nothing?
prefix: At lunch, after three quiet hours, what does Aziz type: his password, his app PIN, or nothing?

text: His app PIN, because the app was idle past the limit, while the grant goes on and its renewal needs no password.
prefix: His app PIN, because the app was idle past the limit, while the grant goes on and its renewal needs no password.

text: The gateway decides, and Keycloak issues.
prefix: The gateway decides, and Keycloak issues.

text: The token names its app and carries the level.
prefix: The token names its app and carries the level.

text: A renewal keeps the session alive with no password.
prefix: A renewal keeps the session alive with no password.

text: And an ended grant stops at the very next request.
prefix: And an ended grant stops at the very next request.

text: On Monday his nephew wants the phone, so Aziz logs out, and Lesson 18 shows how he logs in again on the same phone.
